defs.def: to succeed in doing sth, especially sth difficult 完成（困难的事）；勉力完成

ex.s: Each parking zone consists of multiple lots, designed to efficiently manage traffic across the venue’s network.
ex.t: 每个停车区由多个停车场组成，旨在高效管理整个场馆范围内的交通。

ex.s: After a struggle, she managed to free the vehicle and continued inching along the snow-covered road.
ex.t: 经过一番努力，她设法把车弄了出来，继续在积雪覆盖的道路上缓慢前行。

ex.s: Since setting out on the journey, the ___47___ lover has not only managed to ___48___ an impressive set of muscles but also a huge following on social media.
ex.t: •至少三次双人-教师见面

ex.s: I managed to secure a leadership position.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都需要占用大量空间，尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，但很少有人喜欢在自家附近安装大型太阳能电池板。

ex.s: Being an adult is about having a rooted sense of self while being capable of identifying and managing your emotions and actions. ____38____ We are a social species, so this is important.
ex.t: 也许它在窗户前挣扎太久，累坏了？

ex.s: The Alberta hail project is managed by Terry Krauss, a cloud physicist who works for Weather Modification Inc of Fargo, North Dakota.
ex.t: 选择搭档。

ex.s: Serving hard-to-find Thai dishes in an elegant atmosphere, the restaurant is true to Thai cuisine’s roots, yet still manages to add a special twist.
ex.t: 这家餐厅在优雅的氛围中供应难得一见的泰国菜肴，忠实于泰国菜的根源，同时又不失独特的创新。

ex.s: It’s a surprise they haven’t managed to grow square ones so that they can ___36___ them easily.
ex.t: 真奇怪他们还没种出方形的西红柿来，那样他们就能轻松___36___装箱了。

ex.s: He then handed it to my father, who was trying to manage with the protein bar.
ex.t: "这真的是一种了不起的方式，不仅让我学会了家族的食谱，还了解了家族的故事。"

ex.s: If the field of ALife manages to reproduce life’s endless “creativity” in some virtual model, those same principles could give rise to truly inventive machines.
ex.t: 如果ALife领域能够在某些虚拟模型中复制生命无限的"创造力"，那么同样的原理可能会催生真正具有创造力的机器。

ex.s: He manages a video department.
ex.t: 他管理视频部门。

ex.s: As the night wore on，people began to close their eyes，but the seats were so uncomfortable that only a very heavy sleeper could manage to get any____3____．The woman looked over at the man．He was still staring at her．She looked back at him with fire in her eyes．I was beginning to get____4____，too．
ex.t: 夜深了人们开始闭上眼睛但座位很不舒服只有睡得很沉的人才能____3____睡着．那位女士看向男士．他还在盯着她看．她用愤怒的眼神回望他．我也开始变得____4____不安了．

ex.s: They are well managed.
ex.t: 它们野生动物丰富。

ex.t: C．很难说D．你猜到了我的心思

ex.t: 我在那门____53____课中拿到了A，并学到了让我受益终身的道理，远超____54____。

ex.s: They will be managed by specialists in the next five years.
ex.t: "预算线"一词有几个相关含义，包括几个显而易见的含义和一个不太明显的含义。

ex.s: The US Fish and Wildlife Service carefully monitors and manages the wolf packs in Yellowstone.
ex.t: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局仔细监测和管理黄石公园的狼群。

defs.def: to be able to solve your problems, deal with a difficult situation, etc. 能解决（问题）；应付（困难局面等）
to be able to live without having much money 凑合着活下去；支撑

ex.s: “Our hope is to have a clean, attractant-free place where bears can pass through without learning bad habits,“ says James Jonkel, longtime biologist who manages bears in and around Missoula.
ex.t: “我们的希望是拥有一个干净、没有引诱物的地方，让熊可以经过而不养成坏习惯，”长期负责米苏拉及周边地区熊类管理工作的生物学家詹姆斯·琼克尔说。

ex.s: digest the meal easilyB. manage without breakfast
ex.t: 这些结果的启示是，要从运动中获得最大的健康益处，不吃东西可能是明智的选择。

ex.s: A grasp of how to manage color in your spaces is one of the first steps to creating rooms you’ll love to live in.
ex.t: 掌握如何在你空间中管理色彩的方法，是你创造自己喜欢的房间的第一步之一。

defs.def: to use money, time, information, etc. in a sensible way 明智地使用（金钱、时间、信息等）

ex.s: Therefore, just as we need to be more thoughtful about our caloric consumption, we also need to be more thoughtful about our information consumption, resisting the temptation of the mental “junk food” in order to manage our time most effectively.
ex.t: 反而，我们可以用这个观点来推进科学知识。

defs.def: to be able to do sth at a particular time （在某一时间）能办到，能做成

ex.s: Turner wisely said that “doing well” psychologically is being able to roll with the flow of emotions, manage them, communicate clearly and well with others, and master various skills.
ex.t: 当我张开手时，这只鸟没有飞走；它坐着用明亮的眼睛看着我。

ex.s: So, I called Directory Assistance, got put through to our landlady’s managing agent, and had a spare key sent to me with just enough time to get back in before the actors arrived.
ex.t: 于是，我拨打了查号台，转接到房东的代理处，让人送了一把备用钥匙过来，刚好能在演员到达之前赶回去开门。

ex.s: We managed to leave this spot to climb higher because of the spare time until sunset.
ex.t: 由于距离日落还有空闲时间，我们设法离开这个地点爬到更高的地方。

ex.s: Still, looking back on the photos, they are some of my best shots though they could have been so much better if I would have been prepared and managed my time wisely.
ex.t: 尽管如此，回头看这些照片，它们仍是我最好的作品之一，不过如果我准备充分、合理安排时间，它们本可以好得多。

defs.def: to control or be in charge of a business, a team, an organization, etc. 管理，负责（公司、队伍、组织等）

ex.s: But by learning healthier ways to manage emotions, you can regain control over the food you eat and your feelings.
ex.t: 但通过学习更健康的方式来管理情绪，你可以重新控制自己的饮食和情绪。

ex.s: How he managed his business well.
ex.t: 他如何很好地管理他的生意。

defs.def: to keep sb/sth under control; to be able to deal with sb/sth 控制住；操纵；能对付

ex.s: Somehow they manage to travel around 4,000 kilometres south and find their way to California or Mexico.
ex.t: 不知怎么地，它们成功地旅行了约4000公里向南，找到通往加州或墨西哥的路。

ex.s: Eventually, it manages to reach the places where it will spend the winter.
ex.t: 最终，它成功地到达了它将度过冬天的地方。

ex.s: My family and I have managed to cross the North American continent, from western to eastern Canada, in two weeks!
ex.t: 我和家人已经成功穿越了北美大陆，从加拿大西部到东部，只用了两周时间！

ex.s: We got lost a few times even with the help of GPS, but eventually we managed to cross the Rocky Mountains.
ex.t: 即使在GPS的帮助下我们也迷路了几次，但最终我们还是成功穿越了落基山脉。

ex.s: With help from the artist, I managed to make one in the shape of a fish.
ex.t: 在艺术家的帮助下，我成功地做了一个鱼形的。
